summary: A ranked list of a site's most visited pages, each with its view count, a bar for its share and its change against the period before. A switch sorts the list by views or by change, and the rows slide to their new places. It fits a traffic card on an analytics or marketing dashboard.
use: When you want a quick read on which pages get the most traffic.
When people should spot the fastest growing or falling pages by sorting on change.
When a dashboard has room for a compact list of pages.
features: Each row shows its rank, title, path, view count and a green or red change tag.
A track under each title fills relative to the most viewed page, one row after another.
The header shows the total views across all pages, counting up, followed by `period`.
The Views and Change switch re-sorts the list, and rows slide to their new rank.
Hovering a row shows a tooltip with the full address: the row's `tip`, or `site` plus the path.
a11y: The sort switch is a role="group" labelled "Sort", and its buttons use aria-pressed.
The rows' fade-in is skipped and the total's count-up finishes at once when the user prefers reduced motion.

faq.q: How do I show the full URL when someone hovers a row?
faq.a: Pass `site`, like "designme.dev", and each row's tooltip reads the site followed by the path. Set `tip` on a page to use your own text for that row.
It is the percent change against the period before, like 24 or -8. Positive values show a green tag with a plus sign and negative values a red tag.

faq.q: Can I start the list sorted by change?
faq.a: Yes. Set `defaultSort` to 'change', or control it with `sort` and `onSortChange`.
